$comment: CORS policy for the R2 `aikami-dist` distribution plane (dl.bearlysleeping.com). The client Worker fetches ORT runtime assets (models/ort/<version>/) cross-origin, so a browser needs Access-Control-Allow-Origin; without this policy the bytes are served but the browser refuses to expose them. Apply with: bun cf r2 buckets cors update aikami-dist --body "$(cat scripts/src/lib/dist/r2_cors_policy.json)" (run from scripts/, or use scripts/src/lib/dist/apply_r2_cors.ts). Objects are public, immutable, and non-credentialed, hence origins: ['*'].
